use: Primary view of the pre-1908 Old Cathedral west front in the author’s 1893 travel account.
Smithsonian catalogue marks the original edition public domain.
The excavator reports the 66 by at least 41 m footprint and 3.4 m height of the podium, the west approach, and the square-lintelled portico and flat roof in this phase.
Published archaeological chronology dates the roof and west portico transformation to 1908.
Named present-day outline of the Old Cathedral.
